notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40399944/a2ef7449a2748f568605252c65b9c95b1b386c88.png[/img]
Dear Player,

We have now improved to game to be more refreshing for your eyes.
The display of the windows/text has been improve to make everything more clear to read/look.

At the same time, we fixed the issues reported by the players, thanks to all of you.
